content.query:
let UserInput = "{UserPrincipalName}";
IdentityInfo
| extend UserPrincipalName = AccountUPN
| extend UserDisplayName = AccountDisplayName
| where UserPrincipalName contains UserInput
| summarize LatestTimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated) by UserDisplayName, UserPrincipalName, IsAccountEnabled, MailAddress, Manager, Department, JobTitle, AccountCreationTime, SAMAccountName
| sort by LatestTimeGenerated

let UserInput = "{UserPrincipalName}"; 
IdentityInfo
| extend UserPrincipalName = AccountUPN
| extend UserDisplayName = AccountDisplayName
| where UserPrincipalName =~ UserInput  // Ensure the same filtering method
| project GroupMembership // Retain relevant fields
| mvexpand GroupMembership
content.title: User Group Membership

content.query:
let UserPrincipalName_ = "{UserPrincipalName}";
IdentityInfo
| extend UserPrincipalName = AccountUPN
| extend UserDisplayName = AccountDisplayName
| where UserPrincipalName =~ UserPrincipalName_
| project UserDisplayName, Department, EmployeeId, JobTitle, MailAddress, Manager, CompanyName, 
          Phone, IsAccountEnabled, SourceSystem, TimeGenerated
| summarize by UserDisplayName, Department, EmployeeId, JobTitle, MailAddress, Manager, 
             CompanyName, Phone, IsAccountEnabled, SourceSystem
| take 1
content.title: User Details

content.query:
let UserPrincipalName_ = "{UserPrincipalName}";
AuditLogs
| where ActivityDisplayName == "Add member to role"
| where Identity =="Microsoft Office 365 Portal"
| extend Initiator = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetResource = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where TargetResource =~ tostring(UserPrincipalName_)
| extend RoleAssigned = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[1].newValue)))
| extend RoleAssigned1 = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))[2].oldValue)))
| project TimeGenerated , OperationName, Identity , TargetResource , Initiator , UserPrincipalName_ , RoleAssigned , RoleAssigned1
content.title: Recent Roles Assigned to User

content.query:
let UserPrincipalName_ = "{UserPrincipalName}";
IdentityInfo 
| where AccountUPN =~ UserPrincipalName_
| extend Group1 = tostring(GroupMembership[0])
| extend Group2= tostring(GroupMembership[1])
| extend Group3 = tostring(GroupMembership[2])
| extend Group4 = tostring(GroupMembership[3])
| extend Group5 = tostring(GroupMembership[4])
| extend Group6 = tostring(GroupMembership[5])
| extend AccountName_ = tolower(AccountName)
| summarize arg_max(AccountUPN, Group1, Group2, Group3, Group4, Group5 , Group6 ) by AccountName_
content.title: User Group Info

content.query:
let UserPrincipalName_ = "{UserPrincipalName}";
IdentityInfo
| where AccountUPN =~ UserPrincipalName_
| where isnotempty(RiskLevel)
| where RiskLevel <> "None"
| summarize arg_max(RiskState, RiskLevel) by AccountDisplayName
content.title: Risk State of User

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where Identity contains "{UserPrincipalName}" or InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName =~ "{UserPrincipalName}"
| project TimeGenerated,
          OperationName,
          ActivityDisplayName,
          Category,
          Result,
          AADTenantId,
          TargetResources,
          InitiatedBy,
          AdditionalDetails
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Entra Audit Logs for {UserPrincipalName} in the last 7 days

content.query:
let UserPrincipalName_ = "{UserPrincipalName}";
IdentityInfo 
| where AccountUPN =~ UserPrincipalName_
| extend Role1 = tostring(AssignedRoles[0])
| extend Role2= tostring(AssignedRoles[1])
| extend Role3 = tostring(AssignedRoles[2])
| extend Role4 = tostring(AssignedRoles[3])
| extend Role5= tostring(AssignedRoles[4])
| extend Role6 = tostring(AssignedRoles[5])
| extend Role7 = tostring(AssignedRoles[6])
| extend AccountName_ = tolower(AccountName)
| summarize arg_max ( AccountUPN , Role1, Role2 , Role3 , Role4 ,Role5 , Role6 , Role7 , AssignedRoles) by AccountName_
